### ✨ Streets of Rage 4 Mod Menu (v1.4.5)
Pro Glass UI Mod Menu by **m0hammed** (`@m0hmm3d`) — supports both **Rootless (`arm64`)** and **RootHide (`arm64e`)**.

### 🔥 Mod Features
- **Infinite Life (Player & Allies)** — Zeroes all combat, grab, weapon & poison damage taken by players
- **No Special Move Life Cost** — Defensive, Offensive & Air Specials cost 0 green health
- **Player Super Armor (No Hitstun)** — Players cannot be interrupted or knocked down by enemy attacks
- **Enable Damage Multiplier** — Multiplies all Player & Ally attack damage by the slider below
- **Damage Multiplier** — Scales PlayerAndAlliesDamageGivenMultiplier (Default 5x)
- **One-Hit Kill (1000x Damage)** — Instantly KOs any enemy or boss in a single hit
- **Unbreakable Weapons & Infinite Ammo** — Melee weapons never break & firearms never run out of ammo
- **Infinite Stars (99 Stars & 0 Cost)** — Locks player Star count at 99 and removes Star Move cost
- **No Cooldowns & Infinite Air Specials** — Removes stamina/fury move cooldowns and 1-per-jump Air Special limit

### 🔒 License & Activation
- **1-User Device Lock**: Each token locks automatically to the first device that activates it.
- **Trial & Full Keys**: Supports `2h` trial keys, `30d` plans, and Lifetime keys.
- **Telegram Support & Keys**: Contact **@m0hmm3d** on Telegram.
